minor.issue: The check endpoint (just a preview) creates/updates an insufficient_buying_power_events advisory entry whenever the amount is too high, even if the customer only opened the cost overview and never confirmed. Customers who type a large amount and look at it will produce advisory leads. Probably intended by spec B, but it's worth a product decision.
Duplicate guard only checks status 'pending'. A customer with an 'approved' request that has an open offer can send a second request for the same bond.

ui_bugs.issue: The value is shown as String(iso).slice(0,16), which is the UTC wall time, inside a local datetime-local input. Saving converts it with new Date(v).toISOString() as local time. For admins in CET/CEST, opening and saving a bond moves the validity by 1-2h, which can shorten or expire a binding price.

integration_issues.issue: On 409 the frontend shows a hard-coded duplicate message and does not refetch the catalog. Only 400 triggers retry(). The review note says it refetches on 400/409, so this is a small mismatch.

issues: When a binding price exists but orders_enabled=false, the card still says 'Für diese Anleihe liegt derzeit kein verbindlicher Kaufkurs vor', which isn't accurate. A neutral 'Kaufaufträge derzeit nicht freigegeben – Sie können ein Angebot anfordern' would fit better.
